GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. B — Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Nairobi

12. D — Plan income and spending wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Transport and Communication; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
